Tensile Testing Grips
Wedge Grips
Wedge Grips
Overview:
Tensile testing wedge grips are essential fixtures for securely holding specimens during high-strength tensile testing on a universal testing machine (UTM). These mechanical wedge grips are self-tightening, meaning the clamping force automatically increases as the tensile load is applied, ensuring the sample remains securely in place throughout the test.
Each wedge grip includes interchangeable grip jaw faces designed for different specimen geometries. Flat samples typically use serrated grip faces for maximum friction, while round or wire specimens require Vee inserts for proper alignment and secure gripping. Higher-capacity wedge grips may feature a locking lateral door to maintain the position of the fixed wedge under extreme forces, enhancing safety and test reliability. High powered pneumatic and hydraulic wedge grips are also available, including all pumps, hoses, valves and switches. Universal Grip has the full solution for any brand of universal testing machine.
Universal Grip offers compact, side-lever wedge grips specifically designed to avoid interference with the UTM’s crosshead and columns. While the jaw openings are optimized for thinner samples, thicker specimens can be accommodated with resized wedges or custom inserts.
By using wedge grips, laboratories can accurately measure ultimate tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation without risk of sample slippage. These grips are an industry-standard solution for tensile testing of metals, plastics, adhesives, and composite materials.
